args.title: Issue 4406: change src/import/csv.ts
args.body:
File: src/import/csv.ts

The issue is about malformed row errors in CSV imports, especially with trailing empty lines. The most relevant file is src/import/csv.ts, as it handles CSV import parsing and would contain logic checking rows against the header and rejecting malformed rows, which explains the error on blank trailing lines.
